facts.placeholder_note: ctl/lep/lane core widths are PLACEHOLDERS until HD-CTL ports.json (edit the table at the top of hd_plan.py, regenerate)
facts.orientation_note: bind table instance_orientations (frame_bind ORIENT_BITS): tiles R0 = i W / o E (flow east), MY = flow west; S-half spine nodes MX (i on N, o on S); plan endpoint faces are PHYSICAL (rvcase reprojects view pins)

tile_straps.rule: row0 = rank row base + 128 x bundle; ten = bundle < rank bundles

regions.rule: group = clock region: cl<H><L>W = spo + W chain, cl<H><L>E = spr + E chain, clctl, cllep, cl_<lane>; SerDes edge
regions.crossings: every cross-region link is a landing-plan row (fixed-latency ring, no flow control)

facts.spec_reconciliation: spec v1 s2 "13 levels per half" conflicts with 260 slots / <=5 tiles a row / die ~13 x 20.5 mm; built 7 N + 6 S = 13 levels, 26 chains x 10 slots, 13 spo + 13 spr

physical72.endpoint_geometry: plan face seeds; existing rvcase kit/view pin reprojection required
physical72.relay_cell_packing: PENDING exact master bodies/station collision legalization; no fictitious cell-site claim

package_ports.placement_model: package bumps over/along actual existing interior PMA pin faces; no outer-shoreline path assumed
package_ports.source_ports: retain all existing PMA external connections; actual kit/view pin manifest owed

links.n: ctl sn_o -> spine root (x/go + null best), region crossing
spine return root -> ctl sn_i, region crossing
spine U-turn: top spo.o -> top spr.i
ctl ss_o -> spine root (x/go + null best), region crossing
spine return root -> ctl ss_i, region crossing
spine U-turn: top spo.o -> top spr.i
